objective: Decide whether Juno's AI operating model should use a permanent CxO hierarchy.

context_sources.summary: Juno wants minimum durable agents and task-bounded cognition.
context_sources.relevance_to_decision: Defines the operating-model objective and anti-bureaucracy constraint.

cognitive_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Which constraint actually determines the architecture.

cognitive_needs.why_selected: Permanent role choices can create future bureaucracy and authority confusion.
cognitive_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Delayed effects of institutionalizing role labels.

domain_needs.why_selected: The design concerns decision rights and coordination interfaces.
domain_needs.uncertainty_reduced: How accountability can work without permanent hierarchy.

domain_needs.why_selected: The operating model must support Juno's strategic trade-offs.
domain_needs.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the design preserves strategic coherence.

epistemic_register.statement: The desired operating model minimizes permanent agents.
Dynamic composition can reduce coordination overhead without lowering decision quality.
